name: Uroboros, circulation and trickster
description: The native toroidal whole in eight movements: the round and its trickster costume, position, opposition, the metabolic fork, superposition, interposition (torus and winding), discharge/confinement, and the return with the hole intact.

text.kicker: #0 · native QL/Mytheme register; authored whole-image recovery; quilt §§3–6 toroidal correction
text.title: The snake bends until its head meets its tail
text.italic: The trickster embodies the round presented as the whole truth of the creature — the whole image is toroidal, and its wholeness keeps the opening around which it takes form.

text.body: The snake bends until its head meets its tail; hunger moves along a relation in which eater and eaten belong to one life. This is the whole image developed in Taylor's native register: the uroboros is toroidal, and its wholeness keeps the opening. The trickster wears the circle as costume: head and tail appear to complete a circumference, and that visible completion offers itself as the whole truth. Two consequences are already in

the mouth — assimilation lets what enters change the life that receives it; devouring closure takes everything into an order whose continuation must leave that order untouched. In the Saturnine image the gut is blocked: consumption arrests the generation it claims to sustain. Human-amplified: yes for the toroidal whole, circle/sphere trickster, metabolic fork, Eden relation and complete eightfold recapitulation in the authored quilt.

Occurrences: the bent snake and its mouth (#0); the trickster's circle costume (#0, #1); the Saturnine blocked gut (#0, #2); the quilt's ratified toroidal correction (#0, #3).

text.kicker: #1 · position and opposition; A11 two Ones; A12 monopoly
text.title: Position and opposition
text.italic: The equation demonstrates the cost of the costume: once all difference is inverse quantity, the outcome has no place for the mouth's activity or the body's changed return — it proves no property of circles.

text.body: Position gives the creature a face: seen as outline, its body is a circle; conceived as filled perfection, the round becomes a sphere. A circle is real as a circle; the error begins when its completeness answers for the living whole. The quilt sharpens this through (-1)+(+1)=0 — the cancelling zero takes the office of a terminated account; the arithmetic is exact, its mythemic work is to make the cost felt. Opposition restores head and tail

as oriented terms: the head reaches, the tail is reached; hunger gives the orientation urgency. Neumann's pp.27–35 sequence follows nourishment through hunger, ingestion, excretion and self-formation. The two Ones preserve what the costume conceals: 0 as One, Self-Identity; 1 as All, Self-Difference — neither office can swallow the other. The hungry head becomes tyrannical at the crossing from local appetite to exhaustive authority (A12).

Occurrences: circle and sphere (#1); the signed cancellation (#1); head/tail orientation and hunger (#0–#1); the Neumann digestive sequence (#1, shared archetypal ground).

text.kicker: #2 · superposition of orientations; A03; meta-ballein/metabolism, samāveśa; C24; A27
text.title: The metabolic fork
text.italic: The image embodies the difference between assimilation that renews and detention that prevents generation — participation never authorises one participant to assimilate another.

text.body: Taylor's notation holds both orientations in (0/1)/(1/0): form proceeding from source and form returning to source stay active, the slash retaining their mutual relation. The mouth is the operative opening through which the two orientations meet. Assimilation develops through real change in what receives — meta-ballein/metabolism, with samāveśa carrying the assimilative relation in the authored cross-reading. Saturn-devouring is the obstructed version: monopoly has a blocked gut,

its intake disguising lost circulation. The distinction reaches love: a mouth that takes every answer as confirmation has already become the closed account (C24, A27). The Eden-serpent enters at this authored turn — the hole traded for the fork, good and evil severed from the condition of their discrimination; Frank's Neumann encounter at pp.114–121 reads differentiation's gain together with guilt and loss. This is Taylor's QL refraction, not a claim that Genesis names a torus.

Occurrences: the mouth as opening (#0, #2); Saturnine detention (#0, #2); the Eden fork (#2); samāveśa's authored assimilative relation (#2).

text.kicker: #3 · the torus-cover matheme; A17; C52; A09/C14/C15
text.title: Interposition — the toroidal winding
text.italic: The matheme grounds the exact neighbour: local closure can retain a difference in the wider relation — the mythemic comparison preserves that retained difference.

text.body: Interposition gives the creature its winding: mouth, head, tail, body, inner and outer surfaces, and retained opening in one articulated movement. Taylor's 4+2 keeps four explicate twisting field-lines and two implicates; the quilt gathers axis and hole at #0 while #5 enfolds the differentiated winding. The torus-cover matheme states T²=ℝ²/ℤ², χ(T²)=0, π₁≅ℤ×ℤ: the square's four sides and two generators have different counted objects from the quilt's

four-field-lines/axis-and-hole — a drawing's central aperture is not a third generating loop. The path γ(t)=[2t,−t] returns to its starting address while its lift ends at (2,−1): homecoming with retained displacement (A17). In the authored appointment Anuttara/Paramaśiva owns the opening; Māyā is the measure-field wound around it — the opening never becomes one more bounded patch. The trick succeeds when the formed pattern makes its dependence unavailable to its own account.

Occurrences: the winding body (#3); the retained opening (#0, #3); the displaced lift (#3); Māyā as measure, not hole (#3, #5→0).

text.kicker: #3 · Q27 energetics; ITER source house (bounded technical instance)
text.title: Discharge and confinement
text.italic: The two images witness the native operation without proving it: what the completed surface left out becomes an event it must receive; a field which holds activity through an answerable arrangement can sustain a further passage.

text.body: Q27's earthlight and tokamak pair carries two relations to energetic power. Earthlight carries unconfined discharge: what the completed surface left out becomes an event it must receive. The tokamak holds charged plasma so its activity continues within an arranged containment. An opening is not simply a leak to be sealed, and containment need not be devouring closure. The quilt places the latent dot at the reserve beneath extension, the − under the manifest +: a formed field which denies

its conditions cannot account for their return; a field which holds activity through an answerable arrangement can sustain a further passage. ITER's source supplies the bounded instance — doughnut-shaped vacuum chamber, charged plasma, magnetic confinement — not a universal preference for toroidal confinement. No particular earthlight event is verified here. Human-amplified: yes for the admitted discharge/confinement comparison. This whole returns-to A17 and A18 with reserve/extension intact.

Occurrences: earthlight as quilt-named image (#3); the tokamak's chamber and confinement (#3); the latent dot beneath the manifest + (#3).

text.kicker: #4 · Neumann source house; Frank's protected encounter pp.11–35, 104–121; Jung Aion; Gebser
text.title: The Neumann ground and its variants
text.italic: The shared ground qualifies the native operation without delimiting it: extracting only a perfect circle would lose the bodily and developmental middle that gives the round life.

text.body: Neumann's round is encountered within a sustained account of formation: pp.12–18 open womb, parents, mark and page, and the self-rolling wheel; pp.27–35 give appetite, digestive passage and centroversion; pp.104–121 carry the world parents — separation, light, orientation, guilt. Prajāpati's self-creation and the horse/universe image arrive through Neumann's mediation of Deussen, a nested encounter, not a newly verified Vedic telling. En-Soph

(p.18) and tohubohu (p.106) belong to different inherited traditions read at the indistinct pole without historical identity. The mark-paper-erasure scene compares a second performable return. Jung's Aion sources the Self/shadow horizon; Gebser historicises perspective's release from exclusive claim — neither derives the torus. The paśu correction holds: in the p.105 Ātman passage, I-am recognition precedes the separation into husband and wife.

Occurrences: the self-rolling wheel (p.18) extending continuing formation (#4); the world-parent day/night 4+2 (p.108, #4); the paśu correction (#4, shared with the Māyā whole); centroversion's return beyond gathering (#4).

text.kicker: #5→0 · C21; Arbitration/Hybris/Regard/Anamnesis field; A26; A17; Draft 3; A36; Homologia/Analogia
text.title: The snake returns with its hole intact
text.italic: Recognition restores the relation within the differentiated body: the head remains head, the tail remains tail, and what the passage has changed remains changed — Māyā is the measure, never the hole; the paśu correction holds the ontological order.

text.body: What seemed an absence becomes intelligible as constitutive of the form. C21 defines the return: the image's efficacy remains in relation to what it cannot exhaust; it becomes an idol when its success prohibits the relation from changing it. The Arbitration field grounds the lived consequence: hybris flowers when the local measure claims source authority; regard and anamnesis permit reconciliation and return. A17 qualifies circulation: a completed act can return into another performance, and can come

to rest — making wholeness depend on perpetual production would restore the consuming hunger at the very point of release. Draft 3 sources the terminal consequence: the completed offering is released into lives whose future it cannot command. The eight determinations remain active through the image — eight turns of one relation, not eight phases of a snake. Human-amplified: yes for the eightfold recapitulation and the Māyā-not-the-hole distinction; the paśu correction is shared with the Neumann whole.

Declared cross-story: torus ↔ uroboros with the Māyā-not-the-hole distinction and the paśu correction carried; the Neumann self-rolling wheel extends continuing formation. ↳ Occurrences: the intact opening (#0, #3, #5→0); rest without demanded continuation (#5→0).
